items.original:
On today's stock market crash:

As an investor, on days like today, you have to ask yourself one question: What fundamentally changed over the last 24 hours?

The shift in the fundamental backdrop cannot be attributed solely to the Midterm Election results; markets had already largely priced in the outcome.

So, what changed between yesterday and today? What is the fundamental reason for today's decline?

One of the most likely catalysts is growing concern about a potential "ban" on AI, or at the very least, severe regulation of the industry.

Over the last 24 hours, Democratic lawmakers have publicly called for restrictions on advanced AI development, including an outright "ban on artificial superintelligence."

Frankly, an outright ban will not happen.

Such a ban, if even possible to enforce, would effectively mean the US surrendering its position in the global AI race to China.

Does this mean AI is "over" or today's stock market crash marks "the end?" Absolutely not.

Rather, we believe we are witnessing a sudden shift in sentiment colliding with excessive levels of leverage, potentially triggering forced liquidations by several major institutional investors.

Therefore, today's downturn is more technical than fundamental. This is not to discount the concerns around regulation, they are legitimate. But price action right now does not look orderly or rational.

We are in the midst of the biggest technological revolution in human history.

Zoom out and remain calm.

Let me tell you a story about how unethical Anthropic is.

In April, the Anthropic team began heavily courting our engineering team to tell them corporate secrets, technical details, and future plans for @cfosilvia.

They pretended their interest was due to our exploding popularity and accelerating compute usage, but it quickly became apparent that Anthropic was fishing for details on how we built our product and why it was so popular.

This included the Anthropic team trying to wine-and-dine our engineers, including a infamous steak dinner where someone told our team "don't worry about it, this is on Dario."

Our team was not born yesterday, so we quickly realized what was happening and refused to share sensitive information and technical details with the Anthropic team. 

As we suspected, Anthropic was trying to get information from us, so they could build a competing product. Some people on their team must have a guilty conscious because they messaged us a few days ago to give us "a heads-up" that they were launching a competing product.

Thankfully, the Silvia engineering team has been aggressively working to get off the frontier models for the last ~ 6 months. That effort has been highly successful, because our compute costs are ~ 97% lower when we use our own model & hardware, the latency is lower, and the accuracy of answers materially increases as well. 

The sad thing for Anthropic is they have now released an inferior product and they had to sell their soul to do it. 

The only thing worse than being a trillion-dollar company that can't beat a 10-person team is being a trillion-dollar company that no one trusts and everyone knows is unethical. 

Serious investors continue to choose @cfosilvia over ChatGPT, Claude, and other frontier companies because these products are not optimized to solve the actual user problem.

Today, Anthropic launched a Claude wrapper that is masquerading as a personal finance product. Best of luck to them.

BREAKING: 🇺🇸 Democrats face a push for a “day 1” ban on AI superintelligence, with up to 20 YEARS in prison for violators.

Arizona Rep. Yassamin Ansari says a pause on advanced AI and a ban on artificial superintelligence must be “top of the Democratic agenda on day 1.”

A bill that would do exactly that was introduced by Bernie Sanders and Greg Casar in September.

Under the bill:

- Developing or deploying superintelligent AI would be banned

- Advanced AI development would pause until a new federal regulator sets rules and a model review process

- A new cabinet-level AI department would monitor frontier models and oversee removing dangerous capabilities, like ignoring shutdown commands

- Companies that try to get around it would face the “corporate death penalty”

- Individuals would face up to 20 years in prison

AI and data centers were a “crucial or major factor” for 56% of voters in the midterms, per an NBC News exit poll.

We will all be learning in coming weeks & months, that most human-made software:

▫️ Was really slow
▫️ Had many security vulnerabilities
▫️ Was under-specified and incorrect

AI will rewrite it all. Many times. It will make it fast, cost-efficient, and secure. It will think about failure modes we couldn't wrap our heads around.

It will prove, formally verify, load test, harden. It will turn memory-unsafe foundations into robust, optimized ones. If you ask, it'll thoroughly document it, teach you about it, make diagrams, animations, and slide decks.

In many ways, we are witnessing the true birth of software engineering.

“明明坐拥几万亿资产，为什么还要拼了命工作？”

埃隆·马斯克（Elon Musk）：我十几岁的时候，曾因为过度苦恼“活着的意义是什么？”而差点抑郁成疾。

我翻遍了宗教书籍却无法被说服，转去读哲学书，德国哲学反而让我的抑郁更加严重了。

尼采这类的书真不是年轻时该读的。
但在读了《银河系漫游指南》后，我醒悟了。

并不是“找不到答案”，而是我们甚至连“正确的问题”都还没有提出来。

宇宙本身就已经是摆在眼前的“答案”。那么，对应这个答案的“问题”又是什么呢？

为了找到正确的问题，仅仅依靠地球是不够的。

我们需要更多的人类，以及像 AI 这样的数字智慧。

如果人类不前往火星、不把智慧播撒到整个宇宙，我们将永远无法明白“这个世界到底在发生什么”。所以我现在依然在工作。

简而言之，这不是“成了富翁就想一辈子游手好闲度日”的层次，我只是在赌上全部身家，全力以赴玩一场“揭开这个宇宙真面目的游戏”。

比起吃着美食无所事事度过一生，卷入全人类去解开宇宙之谜要有意义得多
items.original:
「資産何兆円もあるのに、なんでまだ死ぬ気で働いてるの？」

イーロン・マスク（Elon Musk）：10代の頃、『生きる意味って何？』って悩みすぎて病みかけたんだ。

宗教の本を読み漁ったけど納得できず、哲学書に手を出したら、ドイツ哲学でさらに鬱が悪化した。

ニーチェとか若い頃に読むもんじゃない。
でも『銀河ヒッチハイク・ガイド』を読んで気づいた。

『答えがわからない』んじゃない。まだ『正しい質問』すらできてないんだって。

宇宙そのものが、すでに目の前にある『答え』なんだ。じゃあ、その答えに対する『質問』は何なんだ？

正しい質問を見つけるには、地球だけじゃ足りない。

もっと多くの人間と、AIのようなデジタルの知性が必要になる。

人類が火星に行って、宇宙全体に知性を広げていかないと、『この世界で一体何が起きてるのか』は一生わからない。だから俺は今も働いてる。

要は、「金持ちになって一生遊んで暮らしたい」レベルじゃなくて、全財産を注いで「この宇宙の正体を暴くゲーム」を本気でやってるだけ。

おいしいご飯を食べてダラダラ過ごす人生より、全人類を巻き込んで宇宙の謎を解き明かす方が何万倍も面白いから、寝る間も惜しんで働き続けてるって話です。 https://t.co/IybYpmlJnD

items.title:
ChatGPT现在遇上大麻烦了。

牛津大学的研究人员揭示了大语言模型面临的巨大威胁。

这被称为“模型崩溃（Model Collapse）”。

这也解释了为什么互联网即将变成大语言模型的有毒垃圾倾倒场。

眼下，AI公司正在抓取整个网络的数据来训练他们的下一代模型。

但存在一个巨大的问题。

互联网已不再仅仅包含人类数据。它正迅速被AI生成的文本、图像和代码填满。

当AI使用这些数据训练时会发生什么呢
items.original:
ChatGPT has now a big problem.

Researchers at Oxford exposed a massive threat to large language models.”

It’s called "Model Collapse."

And it explains why the internet is about to become a toxic waste dump for Large Language Models.

Right now, AI companies are scraping the entire web to train their next-generation models.

But there’s a massive problem.

The internet is no longer just human data. It is rapidly filling up with AI-generated text, images, and code.

What happens when an AI trains on data generated by another AI?

A new paper in Nature just gave us the answer. And it is terrifying.

When AI models are recursively trained on AI-generated data, they suffer from irreversible brain damage.

The researchers found that the model starts forgetting the "tails" of the original data distribution. The rare, weird, unique, and complex human nuances completely disappear.

It's like making a photocopy of a photocopy.

Every generation loses resolution. The output gets flatter, blander, and more generic, until the model completely collapses in on itself.

For years, we thought the biggest bottleneck for AI was compute, getting enough H100 GPUs from Nvidia.

This paper proves the real bottleneck is us.

If we keep flooding the internet with synthetic AI slop, we will poison the very data pool required to build smarter models.

The ultimate irony? We thought AI was going to make human creators obsolete.

Instead, this research proves that verified, genuine human data is about to become the most valuable commodity in the tech industry.

items.original:
🚨 ¡LA CIBERPANDEMIA YA COMENZÓ! AGENTES DE IA Y HACKERS ESTÁN ATACANDO BANCOS Y EL SISTEMA FINANCIERO 🌐💀

Lo que está sucediendo en Internet durante estas últimas semanas es una auténtica locura!!!!

Mientras los medios reportan incidentes aislados, se están acumulando ataques contra bancos, plataformas de criptomonedas, supermercados, instituciones financieras y hasta instalaciones médicas.

Y lo más preocupante es que ahora tenemos agentes de inteligencia artificial capaces de automatizar ataques a una escala que hace unos años parecía imposible.

Vean lo que está pasando en diferentes partes del mundo. 👇

🇵🇾 1. PARAGUAY
El Banco Central ordenó intervenir Ueno Bank el 3 de noviembre tras detectar una grave insuficiencia de solvencia, dejando a miles de clientes preocupados por el acceso a sus ahorros.

Aún no han explicado la razón de esta crisis bancaria. Esto demuestra lo vulnerable que puede ser nuestra dependencia de las plataformas financieras digitales.

🇫🇷 2. FRANCIA
Crédit Mutuel Arkéa sufrió un ciberataque que permitió ejecutar transferencias fraudulentas por una cantidad millonaria, los primeros reportes hablaban de 133 millones de dólares, aunque el banco asegura que la cifra real es menor y continúa investigando las pérdidas.

Algunas operaciones fueron suspendidas temporalmente mientras intentaban contener el incidente, los fondos de los clientes no resultaron afectados según la institución.

🇹🇼 3. TAIWÁN,
SinoPac Bank registró 427 transferencias fraudulentas desde 419 cuentas, con pérdidas equivalentes a aproximadamente 1.3 millones de dólares.

Lo increíble es que algunos clientes ni siquiera habían iniciado sesión cuando se realizaron las operaciones, el banco terminó reembolsando los fondos.

🇰🇷 4. COREA DEL SUR
37 instituciones financieras afectadas en aproximadamente un mes, 40 incidentes de seguridad, alrededor de 473,000 registros expuestos y cerca de 1,000 millones de wones sustraídos.

Las autoridades anunciaron revisiones de seguridad a unas 580 empresas financieras para intentar evitar nuevas intrusiones.

🇺🇸 5. ESTADOS UNIDOS
14 personas fueron acusadas en Dallas de participar en una red criminal que utilizaba SIM swapping y presunta corrupción de empleados para comprometer cuentas bancarias con más de 373 millones de dólares.

El SIM swapping consiste en secuestrar el número telefónico de una víctima para interceptar códigos de autenticación y recuperar accesos a sus cuentas.

🇯🇵 6. JAPÓN
Empresas de Yamagata perdieron más de 912 millones de yenes mediante llamadas fraudulentas que suplantaban a instituciones bancarias, un esquema de ingeniería social que terminó involucrando investigaciones internacionales.

🇮🇩 7. INDONESIA
Bank Jambi reportó un incidente que afectó a 6,609 cuentas bancarias, con movimientos fraudulentos por aproximadamente 144,820 millones de rupias.

🇧🇷 8. BRASIL
Se reportaron 99 incidentes cibernéticos financieros durante nueve meses, 68 de ellos relacionados con fraudes, una situación que está poniendo bajo presión a los sistemas de pagos y a las empresas que proporcionan servicios tecnológicos a los bancos.

🇲🇽 9. MÉXICO 
La firma de ciberseguridad Straiker investigó al grupo criminal CyberCartel, que utilizó CARLIY0S, una plataforma multiagente de inteligencia artificial, para dirigir operaciones contra más de 400 objetivos financieros en América Latina.

Los investigadores encontraron miles de registros, credenciales, claves de acceso y vulnerabilidades documentadas en los sistemas investigados.

Entre los hallazgos había 43 credenciales de una fintech, incluyendo 11 claves API y 32 claves criptográficas que potencialmente permitirían abusar de servicios relacionados con SPEI.

No significa que hayan hackeado directamente el sistema central del Banco de México, pero imaginen las consecuencias de comprometer una empresa conectada a nuestra infraestructura de pagos interbancarios.

₿ 10. BINANCE
El 29 de octubre, hackers consiguieron sustraer más de 6,000 millones de dólares en criptomonedas desde billeteras calientes del exchange.

El FBI atribuyó el ataque a TraderTraitor, un grupo vinculado con Corea del Norte.

Los fondos comenzaron a moverse entre diferentes blockchains, con conversiones hacia Ethereum y posibles rutas de lavado mediante protocolos DeFi y servicios de intercambio.

El problema es que las transacciones en blockchain pueden ejecutarse en segundos y los atacantes intentan mover los activos antes de que los emisores de stablecoins o los exchanges consigan congelarlos.

🧊 PERO AQUÍ VIENE LO MÁS ATERRADOR, LOS HACKERS YA ESTÁN MANIPULANDO EQUIPOS FÍSICOS.

🇸🇪 11. SUECIA
Atacantes consiguieron modificar remotamente la configuración de refrigeradores industriales en supermercados ICA y Coop.

En uno de los establecimientos los congeladores llegaron a marcar 50 °C, provocando que grandes cantidades de alimentos tuvieran que desecharse.

🇧🇪 12. BÉLGICA
Supermercados Carrefour, Delhaize y otros establecimientos reportaron incidentes similares, con equipos de refrigeración manipulados durante la madrugada y mercancía dañada.

🇱🇺🇮🇪🇪🇪🇳🇱 13. LUXEMBURGO, IRLANDA, ESTONIA Y PAÍSES BAJOS
También se registraron incidentes contra refrigeradores comerciales conectados a sistemas de control remoto.

Estamos hablando de infraestructura OT, Operational Technology, sistemas industriales que utilizan controladores, sensores y software para administrar procesos físicos.

Cuando estos dispositivos quedan expuestos a Internet o tienen mecanismos de autenticación débiles, los atacantes pueden cambiar parámetros de funcionamiento sin entrar físicamente a las instalaciones.

Imaginen las consecuencias de un ataque de esta naturaleza contra almacenes de alimentos, cadenas de frío farmacéuticas o centros de distribución.

🩸 14. FRANCIA
El 2 de noviembre, atacantes manipularon sistemas de refrigeración utilizados por tres instalaciones del Établissement Français du Sang, organismo encargado de gestionar productos sanguíneos en Francia.

Los delincuentes intentaron elevar peligrosamente los parámetros de temperatura y descongelación de cámaras utilizadas para conservar plasma.

Afortunadamente los sistemas de monitoreo detectaron las anomalías y el personal consiguió proteger los productos antes de que fueran dañados.

No hubo pérdidas de productos sanguíneos ni afectaciones a pacientes, pero el incidente demuestra que los ataques informáticos ya pueden representar riesgos para procesos médicos que dependen de equipos conectados.

🤖 15. CIBERATAQUES AUTOMATIZADOS CON INTELIGENCIA ARTIFICIAL

Investigadores también han documentado campañas internacionales en las que grupos de hackers utilizan agentes de IA para investigar redes empresariales, identificar vulnerabilidades, recopilar credenciales y automatizar diferentes etapas de una intrusión.

Y aquí está el verdadero cambio tecnológico!!!!

Antes necesitabas equipos especializados para ejecutar determinadas operaciones a gran escala, ahora un atacante puede combinar modelos de lenguaje, herramientas de reconocimiento, scripts y agentes autónomos para multiplicar su capacidad operativa.

Esto no significa que la IA pueda hackear cualquier sistema automáticamente, pero sí está reduciendo las barreras técnicas para ejecutar ataques cada vez más complejos.

⚠️ HAGAMOS UNA REFLEXIÓN

Durante años nos preocupamos por los virus informáticos que robaban contraseñas o secuestraban archivos mediante ransomware.

Hoy los ataques pueden afectar transferencias bancarias, criptomonedas, proveedores tecnológicos, sistemas de refrigeración y equipos esenciales para la atención médica.

Ya no estamos hablando solamente de información digital, estamos hablando de sistemas informáticos capaces de controlar procesos físicos de los que depende nuestra vida cotidiana.

Imaginen una crisis en la que coincidan interrupciones bancarias, cortes eléctricos, problemas de abastecimiento y ataques contra infraestructura tecnológica.

No hace falta destruir físicamente un supermercado para provocar pérdidas de alimentos, tampoco hace falta desaparecer el dinero de una cuenta para que las personas tengan problemas si temporalmente no pueden utilizarlo.

Por eso considero que estamos entrando en una etapa que podríamos llamar ciberpandemia, no porque exista una emergencia mundial oficialmente declarada o porque todos estos incidentes estén coordinados, sino por la expansión de las amenazas digitales hacia sectores cada vez más sensibles.

🚨 Y MIENTRAS TODO ESTO SUCEDE, LA MAYORÍA DE LAS PERSONAS SIGUE DEPENDIENDO COMPLETAMENTE DE LOS SISTEMAS DIGITALES PARA COMPRAR COMIDA, RECIBIR SU SALARIO, REALIZAR TRANSFERENCIAS Y ADMINISTRAR SUS AHORROS.

Quizá sea momento de comenzar a prepararnos, reforzar nuestra seguridad digital, mantener algo de efectivo y contar con reservas básicas de alimentos y suministros para posibles interrupciones.

Porque el peligro ya no está solamente en que alguien pueda robar nuestro dinero, sino en lo que podría suceder si la tecnología que sostiene nuestra vida cotidiana deja de funcionar cuando más la necesitamos.

¿Ya estás preparado para enfrentar una Ciberpandemia?

Cuéntame en los comentarios, qué medidas estás tomando al respecto.

クレジットカードや運転免許証等の個人情報や金融資産の流出、家庭のIoT機器を踏み台にした企業への攻撃、PHPの重大な脆弱性発見など、国内外でサイバー攻撃事案が更に増加しています。

🚨 IF YOU ARE IN CRYPTO, IGNORE THIS POST AT YOUR OWN RISK

A friend lost $535,000 USDT yesterday, and he even sent a test transfer first. His wallet wasn't hacked and his keys never leaked. He lost it to a bot.

The test transfer arrived fine. Within seconds, a bot sent 1 USDT to his wallet from a fake address that started and ended with the same characters as the real one. Now the fake address was sitting in his transaction history, right next to the real one.

When he went to send the full amount, he copied the address from that history and picked the fake one. The money was gone in under 30 seconds, swapped out of USDT before Tether could freeze it.

This is called address poisoning, and it's running at industrial scale. The bot that got him has run over 6 million transactions, and it goes after anyone moving large amounts.

Here's how to make sure it never happens to you:

• Never copy an address from your transaction history or a block explorer

• After a test transfer, copy the address again from the original message the receiver sent you

• Check every character, because these bots match both the start and the end

• Save verified addresses in your wallet's address book with names

Now open your wallet and go through your history. If there's a tiny deposit from an address you don't recognize, a bot has already marked you. Tell me below if you find one.

Repost this post and share this to the person you know who moves the most money on-chain.

再说一次，很多人对精准卖在最高点、精准买在最低点有一种不切实际的执念。他们想象中有那种从不亏损、把一切都踩得完美无误的职业交易员。

现实远非如此。

交易是一场关于平均数的游戏。

如果我的平均买入价更低，平均卖出价更高，我就能比你复利增长得更快。

精准抓最低点是一件愚蠢的事，做空是用来做风险管理的，不是用来赚盈亏的。

你做空并在盈利时平仓，这样在今天这样的日子里你就能有更多现金。要是我喜欢……
items.original:
Again, people have this unrealistic fetish for closing exact tops, or buying exact bottoms. They imagine the pro trader who never loses and times everything perfectly. 

Reality is far from it.

Trading is a game of averages.

If my average purchase price is lower, and my average sell is higher I will out-compound you.

Timing the exact bottom is a fools errand, shorting is for risk management, not for PnL.

You short and close in profit so you have more cash on days like today. Would I have loved to be short into it? Sure, it would have been an extra +7% or so on our book. That doesn't matter as much as NOT LOSING money, managing your risk and preserving optionality. The sooner you understand this, the more profitable you'll become.

After 13 years in crypto, I can tell you that your best performance in crypto will begin when you:

1. Stop trading (Fully. Period.)

2. Stop rotating (jumping from one coin to another every week, this is pure gambling and you know it)

3. Sit down and understand how every person who's had massive crypto success actually made it (hint: through Holding and only Holding)

今天我与一位资深投资者会面，他认为即使市盈率只有3倍，存储芯片股票也算不上便宜。以下是我们对话的整理版本。

存储芯片的长期协议（LTA）基本上毫无意义。如今签订的LTA充其量只能让客户分担存储芯片厂商的部分资本开支。一旦价格下跌，客户会很乐意放弃押金（预付款）并直接撕毁LTA。

从历史上看，每当价格从峰值下跌超过60%时，客户即便在……之后也会违背LTA。
items.original:
Today I met with a veteran investor who argued that memory stocks are not cheap even at a P/E of 3. Below is an edited version of our conversation.

Memory LTAs are basically meaningless. The best the LTAs being signed today can do is get customers to shoulder part of the memory makers' capex. Once prices fall, customers will gladly forfeit their deposits (prepayments) and walk away from the LTAs.

Historically, whenever prices fell more than 60% from the peak, customers broke their LTAs even after signing them.
So even if a 2027 shortage is certain and the stocks trade at a P/E of 3 on 2027 operating profit, 2028 operating profit is uncertain, which makes it hard to justify a higher valuation.

He went on to argue that even if 2028 operating profit were certain, we would still have to account for 2029 operating profit.

I pushed back and asked why the market doesn't discount TSMC the same way. Why does TSMC get such a high valuation? Wouldn't TSMC also take a big hit if the AI boom fades?

His answer: the problem was how violently memory prices rose in the first place.
If memory makers had raised prices in a healthy way like TSMC, it might be a different story. But because they hiked prices like a commodity, the market has no choice but to treat memory stocks like commodity stocks.

Even if memory makers stay in shortage through 2030, he said, the market will price in the risk of oversupply in 2031.

He closed his argument this way: even at 3x 2027 earnings, if memory prices fall in 2028 by enough to break LTAs, that 3x multiple on 2027 works out to 7.8 to 10x on 2028. So current valuations are not cheap.

A departure from my usual gloating:

If you lost all your money today, I'm sorry that happened. However you must understand that it was deserved. It means you had critical leaks in your trading and you need to take a break. Days like this happen infrequently but they will continue to happen for entirety of your trading career. 

Being levered is reserved for only the specialist of situations, you should almost never leverage. Never allow yourself to be in the position of a forced seller.

If you're having dark thoughts, or feel like you've taken 10 steps backwards and want to do something drastic, please don't. Life is far longer and opportunities are abundant.

Do not trade anytime soon. Go back and reflect on what your leak was (risk management, sloppy order placement, etc.) and learn. You paid your tuition.

If you continue trading without being self critical you are not a trader you are a PROBLEM GAMBLER.

Investing, trading and the journey to becoming wealthy rarely happens overnight. The only way to become profitable is to become your own harshest critic.

The NASDAQ has already given back all of its post-midterm gains, down another 3% today.

Similar thing happened in 2018.

Lot of exuberance following the midterms in 2018 (SPX rallied 2% the next day), then 3 major events caused the market to sell-off into December.

1) A Hawkish Fed: In October 2018, Fed Chairman Jerome Powell remarked that interest rates were still a long way from neutral, signaling to investors that the Fed would continue tightening monetary policy into 2019 regardless of cooling economic data. This triggered severe liquidity fears and widespread panic selling.

This is similar to today in that the market is pricing in 2 more rate hikes despite the sell-off we have seen in tech.

2) Escalating U.S.–China Trade War : Just before and after the midterms, a flood of major multinational companies (including Caterpillar, 3M, and Ford) warned that rising tariff costs were eating into their profit margins and disrupting global supply chains.

This is similar to today as tariffs have had major inflationary effects and is one of the reasons why the Fed has to remain hawkish.

3) Tech Valuation Reversals: The technology sector, which had been the primary engine driving the multi-year bull market, abruptly reversed course in late 2018. We also had the FAANG slump in which major tech giants faced severe regulatory scrutiny over antitrust and data privacy concerns (such as Facebook's controversies).

This is similar to today as the AI trade has taken quite the breather with AI fears mounting.

History does not always repeat itself, but it does often rhyme.

A TON OF THINGS HAPPENED IN THE STOCK MARKET TODAY.

Here's a full recap:

1. U.S. stocks had a powerful post-election rally on today, with the Dow Jones surging more than 3%, its strongest day since April 2025, as investors welcomed the removal of election uncertainty following Democrats taking control of both chambers of Congress. The biggest catalyst was a sharp collapse in oil prices, driven by expectations that the new political landscape could increase pressure to resolve the Iran conflict, potentially easing energy costs, reducing inflationary pressures, and improving the outlook for consumers and businesses. Mega-cap technology stocks, including Amazon $AMZN, Microsoft $MSFT, Apple $AAPL, and Alphabet $GOOGL, rallied as falling Treasury yields and improving risk appetite supported equities. However, the semiconductor and AI infrastructure sectors moved sharply in the opposite direction, with Micron $MU, Sandisk $SNDK, Marvell $MRVL, and CoreWeave $CRWV facing significant selling pressure. Investors are increasingly concerned that a Democratic Congress could introduce stricter data center regulations, permitting restrictions, and higher costs for AI infrastructure development, potentially slowing the pace of capital investment. 

2. President Donald Trump said he is not considering replacing Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, while defending his administration's military campaign against Iran following Republican losses in the midterm elections. Trump acknowledged that it was “largely true” that Republicans lost because of the Iran war, citing the impact of surging oil and gasoline prices on voters. However, when asked whether the conflict was worth the political and economic consequences, Trump responded “yes,” arguing that the United States had little choice because Iran could not be allowed to obtain a nuclear weapon. On the possibility of ending the conflict, Trump declared that “the Iran war will end whenever I want it to,” signaling that he believes the timing of any conclusion remains under his control. 

3. Uber $UBER delivered strong Q3 2026 earnings, with revenue increasing 10% YoY to $14.8B, beating the $14.69B estimate, while adjusted EPS surged 35% to $0.88, exceeding expectations of $0.86. Adjusted EBITDA jumped 31% to $2.96B, ahead of consensus, while free cash flow reached $2.54B, highlighting continued profitability and cash generation. Gross bookings climbed 20% to $59.82B, supported by 215M monthly active platform consumers, up 14% YoY, and 4.1B trips, up 16%. By segment, Delivery revenue surged 23% to $5.49B, Freight revenue increased 34% to $1.76B, while Mobility revenue declined 2% to $7.52B. Looking ahead, Uber guided Q4 adjusted EBITDA to $3.13B–$3.23B, with gross bookings of $63.25B–$65.25B and adjusted EPS of $0.95–$0.99. Management also highlighted accelerating progress in autonomous transportation, expecting approximately 700 fully driverless vehicles operating on Uber's platform by year-end and more than 2,000 in 2027, as the company increasingly focuses on commercializing robotaxi services at scale.

4. AMD $AMD has dramatically increased its unconditional purchase commitments to $48.8B, up 4x from $12.2B at the end of 2025 and $30.3B in June, according to its latest 10-Q filing, highlighting the enormous supply chain investments required to support its accelerating AI infrastructure business. Approximately $33.4B of these commitments are due by the end of 2027, primarily covering semiconductor wafers, advanced memory, substrates, and packaging capacity. AMD also disclosed $6.2B in cloud computing commitments, $13.3B in data center leases it expects to assign or sublease to partners, and up to $8.5B in guarantees covering partners' lease and debt obligations. Notably, lease guarantees nearly doubled to $7.7B from $4.1B in June, although AMD reported no partner defaults or guarantee payments to date. 

5. Alphabet $GOOGL plans to invest $15B in Malaysia during 2027 and 2028, significantly expanding its presence in Southeast Asia through new data center campuses, clean energy infrastructure, water security initiatives, and workforce training programs, according to Reuters. The investment highlights Google's accelerating commitment to AI and cloud computing infrastructure as demand for computing capacity continues to grow across the region. Beyond data center construction, the initiative will focus on securing reliable electricity, sustainable water resources, and skilled workers needed to support large-scale AI operations. 

6. Oracle $ORCL has reportedly canceled a $7B AI chip leasing agreement with Chinese technology giant Tencent following pressure from the Trump administration, according to the Financial Times. The proposed five-year agreement would have provided Tencent access to as many as 100,000 advanced AI chips housed in Oracle data centers across Southeast Asia, representing Tencent's largest overseas AI computing arrangement. The deal would have allowed Tencent to access advanced semiconductor technology that remains restricted within China, prompting U.S. officials to raise national security concerns with Oracle. Meanwhile, senior Chinese officials reportedly urged Tencent to prioritize domestic semiconductor suppliers, adding pressure from Beijing. Although overseas AI chip leasing remains permitted under existing regulations, the agreement was reportedly abandoned amid mounting geopolitical pressure from both governments. 

7. Coherent $COHR delivered a strong Q1 FY2027 earnings beat, with revenue surging 50% YoY to $2.37B, exceeding the $2.31B estimate, while adjusted EPS jumped 80% to $2.09, beating expectations of $1.97. Non-GAAP operating income reached $550M, ahead of the $527M estimate, while gross margins expanded 184 basis points to 40.6%, reflecting improving profitability. The standout was Data Center & Communications revenue, which surged 79% YoY to $1.95B, exceeding the $1.86B estimate, driven by accelerating demand for optical networking and AI infrastructure connectivity, while Industrial revenue declined 15% to $418.6M. Looking ahead, Coherent guided Q2 adjusted EPS to $2.28–$2.48, above the $2.21 consensus, with expected gross margins of 40%–42%. Management also expects FY2027 pro forma revenue growth to exceed 60% and anticipates achieving its first quarter with non-GAAP gross margins above 45% before the end of 2028, highlighting continued operating leverage as AI data center demand accelerates.

8. The top 10 most active options today by contracts traded were $NVDA with 6.3M contracts, $AAPL with 4.7M contracts, $TSLA with 4.0M contracts, $INTC with 2.4M contracts, $AMZN with 2.2M contracts, $MU with 2.2M contracts, $AMD with 1.4M contracts, $PLTR with 1.2M contracts, $SPCX with 1.2M contracts, and $GOOGL with 1.1M contracts.

9. Intel $INTC CEO Lip-Bu Tan purchased 150,000 shares of Intel stock on November 2 at an average price of approximately $64.73 per share, representing a personal investment of roughly $9.7M, according to an SEC filing. The sizable insider purchase represents a notable vote of confidence from Intel's chief executive as the company continues executing its turnaround strategy, expanding its AI and data center business, and investing in its next-generation foundry manufacturing capabilities. The transaction highlights Tan's willingness to increase his personal exposure to Intel's long-term performance as investors assess the sustainability of its recovery.

10. Big Tech stock buybacks are collapsing as AI infrastructure spending takes priority, with combined share repurchases by Alphabet $GOOGL, Amazon $AMZN, Microsoft $MSFT, Meta $META, and Oracle $ORCL reportedly falling to just $4.4B in Q3 2026, their lowest quarterly level since Q3 2017. That represents a staggering 90% decline from the $45.9B peak recorded in Q4 2021, highlighting a major shift in how America's largest technology companies allocate capital. The slowdown comes as hyperscalers commit hundreds of billions of dollars toward AI data centers, GPUs, networking equipment, and power infrastructure, increasingly prioritizing capacity expansion over returning cash to shareholders. The trend signals a significant transformation in Big Tech's capital allocation strategy, with AI investments absorbing cash that might otherwise have supported stock repurchases, potentially reducing an important source of demand for their shares.

11. Goldman Sachs $GS and Apollo Global Management $APO have reportedly begun marketing portions of SpaceX's $SPCX massive $40B AI chip financing package to institutional investors, with individual allocations reaching as much as $500M, according to Bloomberg. The transaction, described as the largest GPU financing arrangement on record, involves an Apollo-backed entity purchasing approximately $47.3B in NVIDIA $NVDA GPUs and related equipment, primarily next-generation Rubin chips, funded through roughly $40B in debt and a $7B lease prepayment from SpaceX. The debt package includes an $8.3B senior-secured loan alongside multiple bond tranches, with the financing structured so that the Apollo-backed entity owns the equipment while SpaceX leases the GPUs for approximately five years. The arrangement is designed to keep the financing debt off SpaceX's balance sheet, although the company remains obligated to make lease payments even if equipment is damaged or operations are disrupted. 

12. South Korea's exports surged an extraordinary 94% YoY in October to $115B, marking the second-highest monthly total on record and the fastest annual growth rate since January 1974. The country has now recorded five consecutive months of export growth exceeding 60%, bringing total exports during the first 10 months of 2026 to a record $930B. The acceleration was overwhelmingly driven by semiconductors, with chip exports skyrocketing 259% YoY to a record $56B, while computer exports surged 497% amid explosive global demand for AI servers and computing infrastructure. The figures highlight South Korea's increasingly critical role in the global AI hardware supply chain, particularly through memory manufacturers Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix, as hyperscalers continue investing heavily in data centers, advanced memory, and next-generation computing systems.

前泽友作先生，您还记得7年前的100万日元压岁钱吗？

其实我就是2019年“#去月球就发压岁钱”活动中获得100万日元的100个人之一。

7年后的今天，我作为轮椅演员参演了相叶雅纪先生主演的电影《4出局》。

看似毫无关联的两件事，但对我而言，一切都是紧密相连的。

话可能有点长，但请听我说。

2019年元旦。

当时还是ZOZO社长的Kabu&前泽先生举办了给100人发100万日元，总额达1亿日元的压岁钱企划。

我以“想给100个人赠送衣服”为由报了名，没想到竟然中奖了。

虽然最初的承诺未能实现，但我用这笔钱给坐轮椅的孩子们送上了一次露营活动。

而且，既然是压岁钱，我也买了一台新相机。

当时，我的YouTube频道“寺田家TV”毫无起色。

然而，用新相机拍摄的视频播放量竟然达到了惊人的600万次。

自此我得以开启了作为YouTuber的人生。

不过，人生并没有那么一帆风顺。

虽然一度涨到了10万订阅
items.original:
前澤友作さん、7年前の100万円のお年玉を覚えていますか？

実は僕、2019年の「#月に行くならお年玉」で100万円をいただいた100人のうちの1人です。

そして7年後、僕は相葉雅紀さん主演の映画『4アウト』に車椅子俳優として出演します。

一見、何の関係もない出来事。でも僕にとっては、すべてがつながっているんです。

少し長くなりますが、聞いてください。

2019年のお正月。

当時ZOZOの社長だったカブアンドの前澤さんが、100人に100万円、総額1億円のお年玉企画を実施しました。

僕は「100人にお洋服をプレゼントしたい」と応募し、まさかの当選。

当初の約束は果たせませんでしたが、代わりに車椅子の子どもたちにキャンプをプレゼントしました。

そして、お年玉でしたので新しいカメラも購入しました。

当時、YouTube「寺田家TV」は鳴かず飛ばず。

ところが、新しいカメラで撮影した動画が、なんと600万回も再生されたんです。

そこからYouTuberとして人生を歩めるようになりました。

でも、人生はそんなに甘くありませんでした。

一時期10万人まで登録していただいたYouTubeも再生数が落ち、登録者も減り、自信を失いました。

外に出ることも減り、引きこもり気味になっていたんです。

でも、このまま人生を終わらせたくない。

もう一度、自分の人生に挑戦しよう。

そう思って、車椅子の人たちが自由に旅行を楽しめる世界を目指し、外出・観光支援のスタートアップを立ち上げました。

そんな新しい挑戦を始めたある日。

YouTubeのお問い合わせフォームに一通の連絡が届きました。

「相葉雅紀さん主演映画のオーディションに参加しませんか？」

あの相葉くんですよ！？

正直、詐欺だと思いました（笑）。

でも、本当だったんです。

映画『4アウト』では、全国約200名の障害者を対象としたオーディションが行われていました。

僕はその存在すら知りませんでした。

実は、稲垣監督が数えきれないほどあるYouTube動画の中から「寺田家TV」を見つけ、「ぜひ会いたい」と言ってくださっていたそうなんです。

そして、キャッチャー富田役に抜擢していただきました。

2019年、前澤さんの100万円でカメラを買い、動画が600万回再生された。

YouTubeで挫折したけど、もう一度立ち上がって会社をつくった。

そして、7年間残してきた動画を監督が見つけてくれた。

今、相葉雅紀さん主演の映画に出演することになったんです。

こじつけだろ〜と思う方もいるかもしれません。

でも、人生って諦めずに挑戦していれば、思いもよらないところでつながっていくんだなって。

前澤さんとは、当選した際にDMで一度やりとりしただけ。

直接お会いしたこともありません。

だから、どうしても伝えたいんです。

あの100万円が、僕の人生を変えるきっかけになりました。

そして、もうひとつ。

あの100万円で車椅子の子どもたちにキャンプをプレゼントしたこと。

それは、自分のことで精一杯だった僕が、生まれて初めて誰かのために何かできたと思えた経験でした。

誰かのために行動するには、自分にも余裕が必要です。

僕自身、今でも余裕をなくしてしまうことの方が多いです。

それでも、誰かからもらったチャンスを、今度は誰かに渡せる人間になりたい。

明日公開の映画『4アウト』は、人生で何度転んでも、諦めずに挑戦する人たちの物語です。

障害のある俳優たちが出演し、スクリーンの中で野球に挑戦しています。

この映画が多くの人に届けば、障害のある人たちが社会で活躍する新たなチャンスにもつながると信じています。

僕はまだ、起業家としても車椅子俳優としてもスタートラインに立ったばかりです。

だからこそ、この映画を大成功させたい。

出演者の一人ですが、一人でも多くの人に届けるため、自分にできることは全部やりたいんです。

そして、いつか。

今度は僕が、100人の車椅子の若者に100万円をプレゼントできるような存在になりたい。

かつて前澤さんが、僕にチャンスをくださったようにです。

映画の中で、キャッチャー富田がブルーフェニックスのレギュラーを目指します。

現実世界の寺田ユースケも、まだまだ挑戦を続けます！

2026年11月6日（金）。
相葉雅紀さん主演映画『4アウトーもう一度、プレイボールー』全国公開です！

ぜひ劇場で観ていただけたら嬉しいです。

そして、SNSのみなさん。

この話に少しでも何かを感じていただけたら、拡散してもらえませんか？

7年前、100万円のお年玉をくれた前澤友作さんに、この映画と僕の今を届けたいんです。

前澤さん、あのときは本当にありがとうございました。

いつか直接、お礼を伝えられる日を楽しみにしています！！！

#月に行くならお年玉
#4アウト
#相葉雅紀

items.original:
The founder of the wearable device Temple, Mr. Deepinder Goyal (who has blocked me on Twitter) has now put out an official statement regarding concerns raised by the medical community on the said device being a scam.

As expected, he has written a word salad. This man has provided no real evidence or proof that his device, which he is selling for INR 85,000/- can measure and interpret brain flow from a superficial artery (superficial temporal artery - which is an extracranial artery - meaning a blood vessel placed entirely outside the skull, supplying blood to the side of the face, temple, and scalp regions).

His own Science Lead (Avi Roy) has accepted that the fact that their device is not yet proven to measure brain flow or "entropy" as they claim on their website and additionally, has directly addressed concerns of poor methodology as well as statisitical misrepresentation, without respond to clear evidence of data falsification in their pre-print papers.

Other wearables like Whoop (which he cited) measured and validated exactly what the wearable can measure within limits of human anatomy and physiology. Temple is overdoing it and defrauding its potential customers. The device can only measure blood flow and flushing to the face in humans and has ansolutely NOTHING to do with the brain as they claim. This is the issue, not what can happen in the future. The device itself fails its primary objective.

There is no our science and your science. But there is bad science, fringe science and science fraud and Team Temple, embraced all of these.

Temple device is a scam. There is no doubt about it. The question is however, how long can this man and his team keep defrauding people under the garb of "we are spending millions for you" or "we are trying our best" or "we are taking the risk" kind of responses?

These farts in the windtunnel responses are not what is expected from a company who's website claims "solid science". There is solid fraud though - pathetic little businessmen.

items.original:
A Gen Z intern told our CEO, "Your presentation was confusing."

The entire room went silent.

CEO: "I beg your pardon?"

INTERN: "You used eleven acronyms in two minutes. Half the people here probably don't know what they mean."

CEO: "They're industry standard."

INTERN: "Maybe for people who've been here ten years. Not for those who joined last month."

I held my breath.

CEO: "And who exactly are you?"

INTERN: "Jamie. I'm in marketing."

CEO: "You're an intern."

INTERN: "Yes. But I was in the audience, and I didn't understand half of your presentation."

Nobody moved.

The CEO slowly leaned back in his chair.

CEO: "Do you always speak this confidently to senior management?"...

Psyhodelik近况如何？

在2026年9月其频道被取消收益之前，他曾提到在YouTube上每月净收入约10000欧元。在失去广告收入后，粉丝社区通过Tipeee平台进行了部分补偿（迅速突破了5000至7000欧元）。这个页面刚刚被封禁至11月底。

在一次Discord对话中，他表示Tipeee被封禁“真的是（他）最不操心的一件事”，他正经历着现实生活中的一些困扰，无法对此多说
items.original:
Que devient Psyhodelik ?

Avant la démonétisation de ses chaînes en septembre 2026, il évoquait des mois à environ 10 000 € nets sur YouTube. Après la perte des revenus publicitaires, la communauté a partiellement compensé via Tipeee (qui a rapidement dépassé les 5 000–7 000 €). Cette page vient d’être suspendue jusqu’à fin novembre.

Dans une conversation Discord, il a indiqué que la suspension Tipeee était « vraiment le moindre de [ses] soucis », qu’il traversait des problèmes IRL dont il ne pouvait pas trop parler pour le moment, et qu’il était tellement stressé qu’il « chi[ait] du diamant ».

On peut en déduire que les difficultés dépassent largement le cadre des plateformes en ligne et touchent à des enjeux personnels ou juridiques plus lourds.

En 2022, Psyhodelik crée une SARL plutôt que de passer en auto-entrepreneur.  Cela permet principalement de déduire ses frais (matériel, déplacements, restos, etc.), ce que le micro-entrepreneur ne permet quasiment pas.

La probabilité de récupérer la monétisation YouTube est quasi nulle. Contrairement au micro-entrepreneur, une société implique des charges fixes (cotisations, comptabilité, éventuel salaire). Ces charges restent dues alors que les deux principales sources de revenus disparaissent durablement. Sur le long terme, la structure choisie pour optimiser se transforme en poids : sans chiffre d’affaires régulier, elle est condamnée à tourner à perte, à consommer la trésorerie restante, voire à faire faillite.

Psyhodelik a probablement enterré sa carrière. Ce qui risque de naître à la place, c’est un casier judiciaire.

Parabéns, mano, por esta caminhada tão bonita! 🙌🏾🇵🇹
Inspiraste-nos a todos e fizeste-nos acreditar que, como portugueses, podíamos ser os melhores do mundo. Fizeste-nos sentir orgulho em nós próprios, como povo e como seleção.
És e serás sempre uma referência para todos nós que te seguimos e que partilhámos contigo momentos maravilhosos, dentro e fora de campo.
A Seleção é o ponto mais alto das nossas carreiras e tenho um enorme orgulho em ter feito parte da tua história. Para mim, és o melhor de todos os tempos, não só pelo jogador que foste e por tudo o que deste à nossa Seleção, mas também pelo que representaste para todos nós.
Mesmo quando muitas vezes discordávamos, estávamos sempre a crescer, a melhorar e a aprender. E isso também te devemos.
Por tudo isso, só posso dizer: muito obrigado, Capitão! O que fizeste por Portugal e por todos nós jamais será esquecido. 🐐👏🏾

- 这部动画原计划在第 136 集完结。然而，据报道，宝可梦公司要求 OLM 延长该系列并加入全新的第 10 世代故事情节，预计游戏将在 2026 年底发布，计划因此发生了改变。

- 第 7 篇章被重写以适应这次延长，早期的第 10 世代彩蛋和铺垫旨在引出第 8 篇章，届时将与新游戏同步上线。

items.original:
Possible Reasons Behind the Pokémon Horizons Production Delay (Unconfirmed Information)

- The anime was originally planned to end at episode 136. However, plans reportedly changed when The Pokémon Company asked OLM to extend the series with a new Generation 10 storyline, expecting the games to release in late 2026.

- Arc 7 was rewritten to accommodate this extension, with early Generation 10 references and teases intended to lead into Arc 8, which would coincide with the new games.

- The production extension was already difficult to manage, as many anime staff members work on yearly contracts. Even the series director reportedly left after episode 136.

- Meanwhile, the Generation 10 games were initially planned for 2026, which also affected the release schedule of Pokémon Legends: Z-A's DLC.

- However, the decision to delay Generation 10 until 2027 was reportedly made much later than expected. This meant the anime's planned Generation 10 storyline could no longer follow the original schedule.

- This forced another major rewrite of Arc 7, removing the Generation 10-related content and requiring changes to scripts, marketing and production plans.

- The Pokémon Company reportedly wanted OLM to extend production once again until late 2027. However, many staff members had already committed to other projects, making another extension extremely difficult.

- As a result, Pokémon Horizons is reportedly expected to stop airing new episodes from around March until October/November 2027, giving the studio time to reorganise production and prepare the final arc of the series, which would introduce Generation 10.

Via ムート

items.original:
Why should Congressional Democrats investigate corporate America if their mandate is to deliver real economic change? Because investigations are a key catalyst for securing reform and legislation. For much of the last century, Congress used to be the main institutional player working to secure an economy that serves working people. A key tool was oversight. Lawmakers routinely investigated complex markets and major corporations, identifying problems and exposing wrongdoing. A major goal of these investigations was to learn what was driving certain problems and figure out how to fix them.

After Democrats took back the House during the first Trump administration in 2019, I joined the House Judiciary Committee as a staffer on the Antitrust Subcommittee. Under the terrific leadership of @RepJerryNadler and then-Rep @davidcicilline, we pursued an 18-month investigation into Amazon, Apple, Facebook, and Google, securing key evidence of how their business practices were undermining competition and harming people, setting the basis for both lawsuits and proposed legislation.

A few lessons from that experience:

1. The quality of legislative oversight depends on the staff and the support of top members to confront power. Committee and Subcommittee Chairs that are focused on getting answers and unafraid to take on powerful corporate interests will make the difference between oversight that doesn’t surrender to their evasion tactics and oversight that aims low or flames out.

Even a relatively small number of dogged, talented lawyers ready to dive in can make a big impact. In the 1930s a single congressional lawyer, Ferdinand Pecora, helped reshape our entire banking system by subpoenaing records and interrogating top financiers, including J.P Morgan. The investigation exposed self-dealing, market manipulation, and tax avoidance, and laid the groundwork for foundational New Deal legislation, including the Glass-Steagall Act and the Securities Exchange Act.

2. Eliminating bottlenecks to moving investigations forward is key. For example, the House should make sure that Subcommittee Chairs can issue subpoenas rather than needing the sign-off of the full Committee or its Chair. A credible threat of sending subpoenas is critical for credible oversight.

3. Ensuring that members can develop the muscle to effectively interrogate CEOs requires investing in real preparation. In the lead up to the hearing with Bezos, Pichai, Cook, and Zuckerberg, the Antitrust Subcommittee spent months reviewing millions of documents collected from the firms, interviewing affected parties, briefing members on key evidence, and conducting practice hearings. Members came into the hearing deeply informed and able to rebut and call out CEO dissembling. The result was some of the most effective member questioning of executives we’ve seen in decades. @TheProspect wrote up a great overview: https://t.co/7BYC3UHFbW

4. For decades, institutional capacity in Congress has been extremely weak. Much of this traces back to the Gingrich Revolution, which was effectively the 1995 DOGE-ing of Congress. Republican leadership fired over 600 professional staffers, eliminated the Office of Technology Assessment, and gutted research capacity. None of that capacity was ever meaningfully restored.

As a result, members have way fewer resources to develop serious expertise or go deep on a new topic. Members should start rebuilding that capacity so the institution can fully play its Article I role, where Congress can again do serious policy development and legislating and serve as a real check on the executive and judicial branches.

5. AI markets should be high on the list of investigations. The business decisions of the major AI firms have huge public ramifications, yet the public is at a severe informational disadvantage when it comes to how these markets work and the choices these firms are making. A congressional investigation will help ensure future legislative action is based on a more complete view of what is going on rather than selective and partial corporate disclosures.

Dear Temple Team,

Doctors are asking for scientific evidence, not your financial history, personal sacrifices, or business credentials. Stop calling legitimate scientific scrutiny “rage.”

You have responded to questions about medical accuracy with investment figures, return policies, personal reputation, and promises of future studies. None of these constitutes scientific validation.

A few simple points:

1.A 14-day return policy is not scientific validation. Patients can feel better on placebo treatments too. Subjective satisfaction cannot establish medical accuracy.

2.Spending $30 million doesn’t prove efficacy. Medical history is full of expensive technologies that failed rigorous testing.

3.Personal reputation is not evidence. Science doesn’t become more credible because a successful entrepreneur believes in it.

4.Customer investment is not independent validation. Financial confidence and scientific credibility are two different things.

5.Promising future publications doesn’t validate present claims. If you make health-related claims today, doctors are justified in asking for evidence today.

6.Individual experiences cannot replace properly designed validation studies. We need accuracy, reproducibility, clinically meaningful outcomes, and independent testing.

And one final point:

Doctors are not against innovation. We are against asking the public to trust medical claims before the evidence is available.

If Temple delivers what it promises, doctors will be among its biggest supporters.

But science is not a popularity contest, and criticism is not “rage.”

You cannot answer questions about scientific evidence with a balance sheet, a biography, and emojis.

Publish the data. Let independent researchers examine it. Let the evidence speak.

That’s all we’re asking.

@theliverdoc

我在加州（湾区）生活了 8 年，在得州（达拉斯）生活了 4 年。

刚去美国那会儿，我觉得加州真的很棒。自由、开放，也曾感动于美国的强大正是孕育自这样的土壤。

事实上，以硅谷为中心，2000 年之后世界级企业层出不穷，我认为重视多样性的加州文化是一个至关重要的因素。来自不同国家的人聚集在一起，多元的思想汇聚碰撞，不断催生出单一民族或单一国家无法产生的新构想和新商业，这正是民主党主导州份的强项。尽管我本人的思想偏保守，但多样性能迸发出如此巨大的力量、单一民族的日本难以诞生这种活力，这可以说是加州教给我的最大收获。

但另一方面，在加州生活多年后，切身感受到的则是高昂的税负，以及公共服务与治安的恶化。如果把州税、消费税、汽油税等算进去，加州是全美税率最高的州之一。很多时候会觉得税负虽高，公共服务和治安却并不理想。

僕はカルフォルニア（ベイエリア）で8年、テキサス（ダラス）で（4年）暮らしてきたんだけど

渡米当時のCA州はほんと素敵だなと思ってました。自由だし、オープンだし、こういったところからアメリカの強さが生まれるのだと感動もしました

実際に、シリコンバレーを中心として、2000年以降次々と世界的企業が生まれてきたのは、カルフォルニアの多様性を大事にする文化が大事な要素の１つだったと思います。いろんな国の人集まり、いろんな考えが集まり、単一民族や単一国家では生み出せない発想やビジネスが次々生まれてくるのは民主党らしい州の強みです。もともと保守的な思考の私ではありますが、多様性はこんなにも力を生み出すのか。単一民族の日本ではなかなかこのダイナミズムは生まれないなと教えてくれたのはCA州での最大の学びです。

一方でカルフォルニアに何年もいると感じてくるのが、税金の高さと住民サービス・治安の悪さ。カルフォルニアは州税、消費税、ガソリン税など入れるとアメリカで最も税率の高い州の一つです。税金が高くても住民サービスや治安が良くないと感じることが多いです

特に、低所得者や医療へのサービスがやはり手厚いようで、僕がたびたびツィートにあげてますが、SF市のテンダーロインとかはホームレスの溜まり場、歩けばマリファナの匂いに薬物中毒者がゾンビのように徘徊。また、銃撃のニュースも絶えない日々です。20年前後はSF市内全域で車上荒らしとかも本当にひどかったです（どちらも今はマシになったと聞いてはいますが26年にSF行った感じだとその感覚はあくまで前と比べてという程度で絶対レベル的には悪いもんは悪いと感じてます）

テンダーロインほどひどくなくてもCA州の高速道路付近はホームレスも多く、バスに乗っても身の危険を感じるようなことも少なくありません。これが弱者や格差是正のための政治を掲げているCA州で起きていることです。最も私はベイエリアしか知らないのですが、LAで運転した時は、バイオハザードのゾンビタウンか？みたいなところもダウンタウンにあったのをよく記憶してます。車乗ってても恐怖を感じました

子供が産まれ、子供を学校に通わせようかなと思うと、今度は住んでいる地域によって学区のレベルが全然違うことに驚きます。アメリカでは学区によって質がかなり違っており、学区の良いところには当然人が多く集まります。CA州なんて所得が高い方多いですから、学区が良いところは家賃がめちゃくちゃ高くなります。CAで子育てされてる方は家賃と学区にめちゃくちゃ頭悩まされてるんじゃないでしょうか？

そもそも、税金こんだけとってるんだから、全ての学区で良い質になるようにしてくれればいいのになと思ったことです。

税金も高いし、治安も悪いし、家賃と学区に悩まされた結果、テキサス州に2021年に引っ越しました。

テキサス州は州税がなく最も税金の安い州の１つです。一方で、弱者救済や格差是正のための社会保障などはCAに比べて充実はしてません。

要はCAは大きな政府・大きな負担。TXは小さな政府・小さな負担という対比になります。また、銃も基本的には所持可能であり、やや危険なイメージはありました。

ただ、きてみるとそのイメージは１８０度違いました。一言で言えば、治安もいいし、街もすごく綺麗。道もCAほどは凸凹してません。最大の違いは治安で、テキサスの一部の地域ですが、なんと小学生高学年であれば1人で歩いて通学できる地域が存在します。そんなことはベイエリアではあり得ません（田舎は違うのかもしれませんが）。また学区の質が地域によってバラバラなのはCAと同じではあるのですが、比較的学区が良い地域が多いように感じます。そのため、良い学区に人が集中せず学区が良い地域でも家賃や家の値段はCAよりはるかに安いです。気にせず良い学区を自由に選べることができます。

実際に教育システムや教育予算がどれだけ違うかわかりませんが、公立学校の視点から見ればTXの方がはるかにCAより充実しているように見えました。

テキサスにもダウンタウン行けばさすがにホームレスはいるのですが、郊外に行くとCAに比べればホームレスは激減します。

皮肉なことなのですが、弱者保護の共助が少なく、自助で頑張れのテキサスの方がホームレスが少なくみえ、薬物・マリファナなどのを含む治安も圧倒的に良いと感じます。あとこれも驚くことなのですが、SF市に住んでる時は、1ヶ月に数回は近所で銃撃事件があったかなと思うのですが、銃が解禁されてるテキサスに来ると5年で数回しか聞いたことありません。治安に関してもテキサスの方がはるかに良いと感じてます。

物価が高いから、格差が広がってるから、生活が苦しいから、などの理由でとにかく分配を強化し、弱者に広く分配すべきだというのは聞こえはいいですが、私が見てきた民主党のCA州では、結果としては税金が高いだけで、住民サービスや治安に関しては恩恵を受けていると感じられませんでした。一方で、そういうサポートが薄いテキサスの方が圧倒的に住民サービスと治安の良さを感じたのは相当な衝撃です。

社会保障や格差是正はもちろんすべきだと基本的には考えますが、民主党の掲げるそれは基本的には違和感を感じます。

Honestly, and Ive told Deepinder about this in private as well, people want to dislike him more than they care about the product. 

He has a polarising perception- either he inspires awe and inspiration, or dislike and hate. No in the middle. 

I use Temple. Ive used it. In fact, I bought it with $$. Its a health tracker. Simple as that. How can you hate a health tracker? Who is forcing someone to buy it? 

There are some ambitious science projects built into it- CBF, Entropy etc. But I would never see someone hate Whoop, Garmin, Gabit, Oura or any other like that. 

People don’t understand second time founder psychology at all. And this is the first sign of a second time founder attempting global tier innovation out of India. 

We need to encourage more of this. Way more. After money stops being the incentive, out best and brightest should build global tier tech- hardware and software.

We're at a turning point in Western culture. 

People have recognized the narratives of the 20th century were largely false.

As a result, many of the narratives that find purchase in the next decade will be of extreme consequence.

Here are five maxims I offer into the zeitgeist with the hope that we can increase the honesty and good faith in the conversations of the 21st century:

1) Ethnic ingroup preference is either immoral for all or it is permissible for all. 

2) Preserving an ethnic and cultural identity is either immoral for all nations or it is permissible for all nations.

3) Applying lower moral, academic, or legal standards to specific groups assumes their ethical, intellectual, or executive deficiency.

4) Accepting or celebrating self-destructive habits is either a form of hate or cowardice.

5) If you cannot be a gracious guest, you cannot expect a hospitable host.

items.title:
煤气灯效应，就算知道这个名字，能在神经科学层面上理解究竟发生了什么的人也很少。

2025年《今日心理学》的解析非常透彻，煤气灯效应是一种黑入大脑“信念更新系统（belief-updating system）”的行为。人类的大脑每一瞬都在判定“是相信输入的信息，还是修正自己的内部模型”。煤气灯效应反复扭曲这种判定，让“怀疑自身认知”永远成为默认设置。在数月至数年的时间跨度里，大脑在物理层面上被重新布线（rewiring）。

其机制在于前额叶皮层（主管现实判断与自我认知的区域）陷入混乱，杏仁核（焦虑与恐惧中枢）慢性激活。这是因为为了消除认知失调，即“自身体验”与“对方所言”之间的矛盾，大脑选择了“把自己的体验当成是错误的”这种节能策略。自我怀疑并非性格软弱，而是大脑最小化预测误差的机制被篡夺的状态。

在封闭环境中效果会放大，这一点在认知科学上也能解释得通。因为来自外部的现实检验（reality testing）被切断了。
items.original:
ガスライティング、名前は知ってても何が起きているかを神経科学レベルで理解している人は少ない

2025年のPsychology Todayの解説が端的で、ガスライティングは脳の「信念更新システム（belief-updating system）」をハックする行為。人間の脳は毎瞬「入ってきた情報を信じるか、自分の内部モデルを修正するか」を判定している。ガスライティングはこの判定を繰り返し歪めて、「自分の認知を疑う」方を常にデフォルトにさせる。数ヶ月〜数年のスパンで脳が文字通りリワイヤリング（再配線）される

メカニズムとしては前頭前皮質（現実判断・自己認識を司る領域）が混乱し、扁桃体（不安・恐怖の中枢）が慢性的に活性化する。これは認知的不協和——「自分の体験」と「相手に言われていること」の矛盾——を解消するために、脳が「自分の体験の方を間違いだったことにする」という省エネ戦略を選ぶから起きる。自己不信は性格の弱さではなく、脳の予測誤差最小化メカニズムが乗っ取られた状態

閉鎖的な環境で効果が増幅するのも認知科学的に説明がつく。外部からの現実検証（reality testing）が遮断されると、脳は相手の情報だけを「正しい入力」として処理するようになる。DV・カルト・ブラック企業で同じ構造が観察されるのは偶然ではなく、情報環境の閉鎖性がガスライティングの必要条件

2023年にWillis Klein, Li, Woodが65人の被害者へのインタビューに基づく初の大規模実証研究を発表している。それまでガスライティングは概念的な議論が多く、実証データが乏しかった。この研究で加害者の戦術パターンが体系化されたことで、学術的にもようやく「精神的虐待の一形態」として研究対象になり始めた

「自分も少し経験したことあるがマジで自己不信になって頭おかしくなりそうだった」——これはまさに脳の反応として正常。自己不信が生まれること自体がガスライティングの目的であり成果だから、「おかしくなりそうだった」と感じた時点で脳は正しく反応している。問題は脳ではなく環境にある

回復には認知行動療法（CBT）が有効で、歪められた信念更新システムを再訓練する。回復率は65-80%と報告されているが、「自分がガスライティングを受けていた」と認識すること自体が回復の最大のハードル。認識できた時点で半分勝っている

•  Adults role-playing as children under 16

🚨 闻起来有一股洗钱的味

绝对的丑闻。在2023年至2025年期间，国家彩票局在没有任何领奖人身份文件的情况下发放了341笔奖金：总计580万欧元。

另有178份卷宗资料不完整……涉及另外900万欧元。总计呢？在不知道领奖人是谁的情况下分发了1479万欧元。

你明白问题的严重性了吗？

这些卷宗属于2023年至2025年。在整个期间，负责彩票业务的部门一直由玛丽亚·赫苏斯·蒙特罗掌管。而执掌该企业的高管正是她在2018年提拔安插的人选。
items.original:
🚨 HUELE A BLANQUEO

Escándalo absoluto. Entre 2023 y 2025, Loterías del Estado pagó 341 premios sin documentación de quién los cobró: 5,8 millones de euros.

Otros 178 expedientes la tenían incompleta... 9 millones más. ¿Total? 14,79 millones repartidos sin saber a quién.

¿Entiendes la gravedad?

Los expedientes son de 2023 a 2025. Durante todo ese tiempo, el ministerio del que depende Loterías lo dirigía María Jesús Montero. Y al frente de la empresa estaba el hombre que ella colocó en 2018.

Y la ley es clara: SELAE está OBLIGADA a identificar a quien cobra y a guardar el décimo original.

La abogada María Abad, que lo ha denunciado, lo resume en tres palabras: "huele a blanqueo".

Ella sostiene además que la Fiscalía intentó archivar su denuncia.

Ahora piensa cómo funciona esto. Si alguien tiene dinero negro y encuentra a un premiado dispuesto a venderle el décimo, ese dinero sale limpio del Estado, con su justificante fiscal y todo.

Ha habido casos muy raros.

Carlos Fabra, por ejemplo, expresidente de la Diputación de Castellón, declaró 7 grandes premios de la Lotería de Navidad y del Niño: 145 papeletas premiadas. Muy raro, ¿no?

Para que eso no pase existe precisamente la obligación de documentar quién cobra.

¡Pues 341 veces no se documentó! ¿Entiendes eso? Es fuerte, eh. Huele que apesta... ¿quién ha cobrado ese dinero? Nadie lo sabe.

Todo huele a podrido en España. Nada se salva.

Esta semana mando a mi comunidad un manual para protegerse de lo que viene. Pintan bastos.

🚨 证物遭拆解报废

性质极其恶劣。你简直无法相信。1月18日在阿达穆斯发生的事故导致46人死亡。外界盛传存在失职渎职。

十个月后，那列火车的黑匣子竟然不翼而飞。而且不是沉在海底：而是在杜斯埃尔马纳斯的一处废品拆解厂。

国民警卫队在堆成八米高、重达350吨的废铁堆中搜寻了两次。找到了原本安装黑匣子的机柜。但是……里面空空如也。

记录上是这样解释的：他们把火车切割拆解，装上卡车，运到了拆解厂

🚨 DESGUAZAN LAS PRUEBAS

Es gravísimo. No lo vas a creer. 46 muertos en Adamuz el 18 de enero. Se habla de negligencia.

Diez meses después, las cajas negras de ese tren están perdidas. Y no en el fondo del mar: en un desguace de Dos Hermanas.

La Guardia Civil ha hecho dos búsquedas entre 350 toneladas de chatarra apilada en una montaña de ocho metros. Encontró los armarios donde iban acopladas. Pero... Vacíos.

El acta lo explica así: cortaron el tren, lo cargaron en camiones, lo llevaron al desguace y lo apilaron. 

Después de eso, dan por imposible encontrarlas. Imposible.

Léelo otra vez. Trocearon y achatarraron el tren de un accidente con 46 muertos sin haber sacado antes las cajas negras. ¿No es tercermundista? Falta de control total.

Esos aparatos guardan lo que hizo el sistema de frenado en los últimos segundos. Lo que podría explicar qué pasó de verdad.

Y la jueza no ordenó buscarlas hasta septiembre. Ocho meses después. ¡OCHO MESES!

Mientras tanto, en octubre, murieron 69 personas más en la misma línea.

Si en enero hubiéramos sabido qué falló, igual la gente de Urda estaría viva.

Pero nunca lo sabremos.
Y eso es exactamente el problema. ¿No te parece? Muchos se irán de rositas gracias a esto.

Aujourd’hui, nous étions dans la rue. Et nous étions nombreux.

Près de 1,6 million de manifestantes et manifestants partout en France dans plus de 180 cortèges : la journée la plus massive depuis le début du mouvement.

Et pourtant, on a tout fait pour nous en empêcher. Ce matin, la Préfecture de police a coupé les RER et Transilien de la gare de Saint-Denis vers Paris. Des milliers d’habitantes et d’habitants privés de leur principal moyen de rejoindre le cortège. Une mesure générale, indiscriminée, disproportionnée, qui frappe toute une population au seul motif qu’elle vit en banlieue.

Les quartiers populaires n’ont pas à être interdits de manifestation. Notre liberté de circuler, notre droit de manifester valent autant que ceux de n’importe qui dans ce pays. Cette fuite en avant autoritaire doit cesser.

Parcours interdit, cortège relégué entre République et Nation, trains coupés : qu’importe. Le boulevard Voltaire était plein, et j’y ai marché avec celles et ceux de Saint-Denis–Pierrefitte qui ont trouvé le moyen d’être là malgré tout.

Ce que nous sommes venus dire est simple. On ne vit pas avec des salaires gelés quand les loyers, les courses et l’énergie s’envolent. Dans nos quartiers, la vie chère n’est pas un indicateur économique : c’est le quotidien de chaque fin de mois.

Ce soir, le pouvoir annonce une « conférence sociale ». Mais on ne répond pas à des millions de voix par une réunion de plus. On y répond par des actes : augmenter les salaires, protéger les locataires, financer l’école et l’hôpital.

La rue a parlé. Elle reparlera, toutes et tous ensemble, sans distinction de territoire.

【速报】逮捕涉嫌从日本向俄罗斯非法出口、让日本成为国际叛徒的韩国籍男子：“他是因出口受强化制裁对象而被捕的唯一一人”

浜田海上保安部于 11 月 4 日宣布，因涉嫌非法出口限制向俄罗斯出口的二手车，逮捕了涉嫌违反《外汇法》的韩国籍贸易从业者金俊浩（音译，36 岁）被告。松江地检已按违反该法起诉。

■已查明的内容
・涉嫌于 2025 年 9 月和 11 月从岛根县滨田港共计出口 73 辆二手车

・涉嫌在未取得经济产业大臣许可的情况下向俄罗斯出口

・2023 年强化对俄制裁后，围绕受限制车辆非法出口的起诉在全国尚属首例

🚨 他们给她买了一套公寓

简直疯了。中央行动组（UCO）今早在瓦伦西亚前部长本人的家中逮捕了阿瓦洛斯的伴侣。你知道为什么吗？看好了。

安德烈娅·德拉托雷，28岁。被捕原因是涉嫌洗钱：阿瓦洛斯/科尔多贪腐网络据称为她买了一套公寓……没人搞得懂为什么。

她行使了保持沉默的权利。并且指定了与她被关押的男友何塞·路易斯·阿瓦洛斯相同的辩护律师。

但这事并不关乎她一个人。
整起案件的牵扯远比这深得多。
items.original:
🚨LE COMPRARON UN PISO

Qué locura. La UCO ha detenido esta mañana a la pareja de Ábalos en la misma casa del exministro, en Valencia. ¿Sabes por qué? Atento.

Andrea de la Torre, 28 años. La detención es por presunto blanqueo de capitales: la trama de Ábalos / Koldo le habría comprado un piso... nadie entiende por qué.

Se ha acogido a su derecho a no declarar. Y ha designado como abogado al mismo que lleva a su novio encarcelado, JL Ábalos.

Pero esto no va de ella.
La trama va mucho más allá.

Fíjate:
Son 6 los detenidos hoy. Entre ellos, el señalado como exchófer de Pedro Sánchez. Lo cuentan fuentes jurídicas consultadas por Libertad Digital.

El juez Ismael Moreno abrió el martes una pieza secreta nueva del caso Koldo para investigar amaños en contratos de obra pública durante la etapa de Ábalos en Transportes.

Y fíjate dónde se han plantado los agentes esta mañana: en la sede de Adif.

La misma empresa en la que hace ocho días murieron 69 personas. La misma a la que se acusa de graves casos de enchufismo.

Ábalos ya está condenado a 24 años. Koldo, a 19. Y la investigación sobre quién se repartía las obras públicas sigue abierta, entrando otra vez por la misma puerta.

Ocho días. 
Dos escándalos. 
La misma casa.

¿Te gusta cómo esta quedando España tras 8 años de sanchismo?

【没有更新的 iPhone，只要打开网页就会被窃取内容】

先说明一下，按时更新 iPhone 的人与此无关。
请冷静阅读：

11 月 4 日，美国政府网络安全机构（CISA）将苹果的一个漏洞列入了“已被实际利用的漏洞”清单中。
那个漏洞，其实是苹果在 2024 年 5 月就已经修复了的。
两年半前修复的漏洞，现在仍在被利用。
成为目标的是那些系统停留在 iOS 16、17 等旧版本，以及留在 18 但低于 18.7.7 的设备。

它的机制是只要打开网页，无需任何点击操作就会被窃取 Cookie 和短信。
发现该漏洞的网站分布在乌克兰、美国、捷克等国，目前尚未出现日本网站的报告。
我原本以为“修好的漏洞就成过去式了”，但对于停止更新的设备来说，旧漏洞反而成了最主要的突破口。

▼具体是怎么回事（截至 11 月 5 日）

漏洞编号为 CVE-2024-27834，
是 Safari 内核（WebKit）的漏洞，在 2024 年 3 月的黑客大赛 Pwn2Own 上由研究员 Manfred Paul 进行了实机演示，苹果
items.original:
【更新していないiPhoneは、サイトを開くだけで中身を抜かれます】

先に言っておくと、iPhoneをちゃんと更新している人には関係ない話です
落ち着いて読んでください

11月4日、米国政府のサイバーセキュリティ機関（CISA）が、Appleの穴を「実際に悪用された穴」のリストに追加しました
その穴、Appleが2024年5月に直したやつです
2年半前に直った穴が、今も使われている
狙われているのは、iOSを16や17の古いままにしている端末と、18のまま18.7.7より前で止めている端末です

サイトを開くだけで、タップ無しでCookieやメッセージを抜かれる作りです
見つかったのはウクライナ・米国・チェコなどのサイトで、日本のサイトは報告に出ていません
私は「直った穴は終わった話」だと思っていたんですが、更新を止めた端末にとっては、古い穴の方が本命の入口でした

▼何の話か（11月5日時点）

穴の番号はCVE-2024-27834
Safariの中身（WebKit）の穴で、2024年3月のハッキング大会Pwn2Ownで研究者のManfred Paulさんが実演して、Appleが5月13日に直しました
（iOS 17.5、古い機種向けの16.7.8、macOS 14.5、Safari 17.5）

危険度の点数は10点満点で5.5と、低めです
というのも、この穴は単体では何もできません
すでに端末のメモリを読み書きできる攻撃者が、Appleのチップの防御（ポインタ認証。命令の飛び先が書き換えられていないか確かめる仕組み）をすり抜けるための穴で、別の穴とセットで初めて効きます

今回、フランスのセキュリティ会社Sekoiaが11月4日に公表した攻撃「Poisoned Source」の中で、2025年12月に直ったWebKitの穴（CVE-2025-43529）とセットで使われているのが見つかりました
それを受けてCISAがリストに入れた、という流れです

▼どう仕掛けられていたか

入口は3つ
・正規サイトの改ざん（ウクライナのガス会社、米国の化学業界団体、チェコの政党、ブルガリアの軍関連、オーストラリアの医院）
・本物そっくりのドメイン（米国の建国250周年の公式サイト風、ロンドンの高級ホテル風）
・ウクライナのアクセス解析サービスPlerdyのスクリプト改ざん（8月27日〜9月3日の1週間。これを読み込んでいた数千のサイトに波及。大半はウクライナのサイト）

ページを開くだけで、タップは要りません
端末の種類とOSを判定して、合う攻撃だけを送ってきます

・iOS 16.7向け（実際は16.0〜17.4で動く）→ ブラウザのCookieを盗む
・iOS 18.5向け（18.4〜18.7で動く「DarkSword」という市販の攻撃キットの流用）→ SMS、iMessage、メール、WhatsAppとTelegramの中身、保存したパスワード、Wi-Fiのパスワード、Safariの履歴、連絡先、通話履歴、写真、位置情報、ヘルスケアまで
・Android向け（Chrome 139〜145）→ ChromeのCookieとログイン情報

端末に居座らない作りなので、再起動すれば止まります
ただし、またそのサイトを開けば入り直されます

犯人はロシアの情報機関系のAPT29だとSekoiaは見ています
ただ「中〜高の確信度」で、断定ではありません
要人狙いなのか無差別なのかも分かっていません

▼自分は対象か

設定→一般→情報で、iOSのバージョンを見てください

・27.2、26.7.2、18.7.11（どれも10月27日配信）→ 今回の穴は全部ふさがっています
・18.4〜18.7.6で止めている → 今すぐ更新
　18.7.7以降で攻撃キットの穴は全部ふさがっていて、Apple自身が更新の説明にDarkSwordという名前を出して、Web攻撃からの保護だと書いています
・17.5〜18.3で止めている → 今回の攻撃の対象外　ただし古いので更新を
・17.0〜17.4で止めている → 更新
・iPhone 8、8 Plus、X（iOS 16が上限）→ 16.7.8（2024年5月）以降なら今回の穴はふさがっています
　出ている中で一番新しい16.7.xにしておく
・Mac → 今回の攻撃はスマホ狙いで対象外
　穴自体はSafari 17.5／macOS 14.5以降でふさがっています
・Android → Chromeと本体の更新を最新に

ついでに、設定→一般→ソフトウェアアップデート→自動アップデートをオンに
Appleは、自動アップデートがオンなら18.7.7が自動で入ると書いています
更新できない端末で防ぐ方法は、ブラウザを使わない以外にほぼありません

▼来そうな質問に先に答えておきます

「2年前の穴なのに今さら？」
その通りで、穴は直っています
今回のは「直した穴が、更新していない端末でまだ使われている」という話で、新しい穴ではないです

「点数5.5なら大したことないのでは」
単体ではその通りです
ただ、メモリを読み書きできる別の穴の後ろに付けて、Appleチップの防御を抜く部品として使われました
点数が低い穴でも、組み合わせの部品としては価値が残ります

「感染しているか確かめたい」
一般の人が確かめる手段は公開されていません（判定に使う情報はSekoiaが捜査機関向けにだけ出しています）
端末に居座らないので、まず再起動、次に更新
心配なら、Safariの履歴とCookieを消して、主要なサービスのパスワードを変えるのが現実的な線です

「日本のサイトは大丈夫？」
報告に無いだけで、無いことの証明ではありません
攻撃キットDarkSwordは今年3月にネットに流出していて、今回の犯人以外も使える状態です
日本向けのサイトに仕込まれない保証はないです

「CISAのリストって何？」
米国の政府機関に「11月18日までに対処しろ」と言うための手続きです（期限は報道ベース）
リストに載ったからといって、一般の人の危険が今日から増えた訳ではありません

▼最後に

更新を後回しにしている端末は、新しい穴より「2年前の穴」で抜かれます
更新ボタンを押すのが一番安い対策です
27にするのが怖い人は26.7.2でいいです
今回の穴はそこでふさがっています

🚨 我提出了一项法案，要求将午餐时间计入工作时长！

如今，每天工作8小时的人通常需要将人生中的9个小时奉献给工作。这是因为午休时间并未计入工时当中。

但这一个小时并不是完全自由的时间。劳动者无法自选吃午餐的时间，而且往往无法回家、接孩子放学或处理个人私事。他们必须根据工作时
items.original:
🚨 APRESENTEI UM PROJETO DE LEI PARA QUE A HORA DO ALMOÇO CONTE COMO HORA TRABALHADA!

Hoje, quem trabalha 8 horas por dia geralmente precisa dedicar 9 horas da sua vida ao emprego. Isso porque a hora do almoço não é contabilizada na jornada de trabalho.

Mas essa hora não é um tempo plenamente livre. O trabalhador não escolhe quando vai almoçar e, muitas vezes, não consegue voltar para casa, buscar os filhos na escola ou resolver questões pessoais. Precisa organizar sua vida de acordo com os horários definidos pela empresa.

Meu projeto muda essa realidade: quem cumpre uma jornada de 8 horas poderá trabalhar 7 horas e ter 1 hora de almoço, sem redução salarial e mantendo o direito ao descanso.

Afinal, a pausa para alimentação também beneficia as empresas, que precisam de trabalhadores descansados e atentos.

Parabéns, mano, por esta caminhada tão bonita! 🙌🏾🇵🇹
Inspiraste-nos a todos e fizeste-nos acreditar que, como portugueses, podíamos ser os melhores do mundo. Fizeste-nos sentir orgulho em nós próprios, como povo e como seleção.
És e serás sempre uma referência para todos nós que te seguimos e que partilhámos contigo momentos maravilhosos, dentro e fora de campo.
A Seleção é o ponto mais alto das nossas carreiras e tenho um enorme orgulho em ter feito parte da tua história. Para mim, és o melhor de todos os tempos, não só pelo jogador que foste e por tudo o que deste à nossa Seleção, mas também pelo que representaste para todos nós.
Mesmo quando muitas vezes discordávamos, estávamos sempre a crescer, a melhorar e a aprender. E isso também te devemos.
Por tudo isso, só posso dizer: muito obrigado, Capitão! O que fizeste por Portugal e por todos nós jamais será esquecido. 🐐👏🏾

items.original:
When Putin seized Crimea, both Europe and America were quite openly making calls, holding meetings, and sending signals to the Ukrainians who were in power at the time that there should be no escalation – let's just keep things friendly and leave things as they are for now. And we lost Crimea. After that, we lost part of Donbas. But the shooting in the east continued. There was no peace.

People think we were always helped. That is not true. Help started coming after the full-scale invasion, but that was after eight years of Russia occupying our territory. That is a long time to figure things out and understand that Putin has no intention of giving anything back to us.

At one point, some Europeans asked me: “Why do you think that if you withdraw from Donbas, he will go further?” And I answered: “Because at the beginning of the war, he wasn't seizing Donbas. He came to the capital. He seized parts of Zaporizhzhia and Kherson regions, Kherson itself, and Kharkiv region.” We have retaken a lot of territory, but he had seized different parts of our country. And now they want us to give them something because they are unable to seize it. We may have a smaller territory, less money, and fewer weapons, but we still have more dignity than many others. We will do everything we can to end this war, but it must end in a way that preserves our dignity.

From an interview with ZDF. (2/3)

events.summary:
“明明坐拥几万亿资产，为什么还要拼了命工作？”

埃隆·马斯克（Elon Musk）：我十几岁的时候，曾因为过度苦恼“活着的意义是什么？”而差点抑郁成疾。

我翻遍了宗教书籍却无法被说服，转去读哲学书，德国哲学反而让我的抑郁更加严重了。

尼采这类的书真不是年轻时该读的。
但在读了《银河系漫游指南》后，我醒悟了。

并不是“找不到答案”，而是我们甚至连“正确的问题”都还没有提出来。

宇宙本身就已经是摆在眼前的“答案”。那么，对应这个答案的“问题”又是什么呢？

为了找到正确的问题，仅仅依靠地球是不够的。

我们需要更多的人类，以及像 AI 这样的数字智慧。

如果人类不前往火星、不把智慧播撒到整个宇宙，我们将永远无法明白“这个世界到底在发生什么”。所以我现在依然在工作。

简而言之，这不是“成了富翁就想一辈子游手好闲度日”的层次，我只是在赌上全部身家，全力以赴玩一场“揭开这个宇宙真面目的游戏”。

比起吃着美食无所事事度过一生，卷入全人类去解开宇宙之谜要有意义得多

在政府效率部（DOGE）之后，埃隆得出了一个大多数人都忽略的结论。

他曾试图从内部改革体制，但他失败了。而且他说得很直白：政府根本解决不了自身的赤字。掌权者没有一个真正想削减开支，体制机器只会保护它自己。

因此他得出了唯一合乎逻辑的结论。如果体制无法被改革，那么结局只有两种走向。

要么是全球破产：债务持续复利累积，利息支出吞噬财政预算，整个系统在其自身重负下彻底崩溃。

要么是机器人
items.original:
After DOGE, Elon came to a conclusion most people missed.

He tried to reform the state from the inside. He failed. And he said it plainly: the government can't fix its own deficit. Nobody in power actually wants to cut. The machine protects itself.

So he drew the only logical conclusion. If the state can't be reformed, there are only two ways this ends.

Either global bankruptcy. Debt keeps compounding, interest payments eat the budget, and the system collapses under its own weight.

Or robots. AI and robotics grow the economy so fast that the debt becomes manageable, and abundance makes the old fights over scarcity irrelevant.

Here's the part almost nobody sees.

For two centuries, capitalism has had a marketing problem. Its gains are real but slow and invisible. 2% growth a year doesn't feel like anything. Your life gets better over 30 years and you never connect it to the system that did it. Meanwhile, the left's promises feel immediate and concrete: a check, a subsidy, a benefit. That's why the left wins on promises even when it can't deliver them. Capitalism produces the wealth, socialism takes the credit.

Robots break that asymmetry.

When productivity doubles in a few years instead of a few decades, people will see it. Things get cheaper, services get better, opportunities appear, in real time. For the first time in history, people will connect capitalism and their rising standard of living directly, almost instantly. The causal chain becomes visible.

And that changes everything politically.

So there are two scenarios.

Scenario one: we stay in the current inertia. No breakthrough, or a breakthrough we regulate to death. The debt wins. Living standards stagnate, then fall. A frustrated electorate turns to whoever promises the most, and that pushes toward a hard collectivist left. But collectivism fails, as it always does. And when it fails, the most organized, most disciplined collectivist force left standing isn't the old left. It's radical Islamism. Bankruptcy, then communism, then something worse.

Scenario two: robots win. Abundance arrives, and it arrives visibly. The link between free enterprise and prosperity becomes obvious to everyone. And this is the key point: it becomes obvious to everyone, including the minorities the left was counting on. Because their long-term incentive is the same as everyone else's. A kid in the suburbs gains infinitely more from a booming, abundant West than from a bankrupt state handing out promises it can't keep. Abundance is the most powerful integration machine ever built.

That's the Western renaissance.

The West doesn't need to win the culture war by arguing. It needs to win it by delivering. And for the first time, it has the technology to deliver fast enough for people to notice.

The race isn't left vs right anymore. It's robots vs bankruptcy.

在谷歌收购了我的AR初创公司后，我开始思考下一个交互界面，这一次是为了AI。文本和语音效果不错，就像Mac出现之前的DOS系统一样。但没有什么比面对面更直观的了。

经过两年的研究，今天我们推出了Atmee v2：一个实时虚拟化身模型，让实时视频智能体显得真正栩栩如生。

· 仅凭1张图片加10秒音频生成任意角色
· 契合语境的表情、手势，甚至能与环境交互
· 实时视频通话、仅语音，或
items.original:
After Google acquired my AR startup, I started thinking about the next interface, this time for AI. Text and voice work fine, just like DOS did before the Mac. But nothing’s more intuitive than face to face.

After two years of research, today we’re launching Atmee v2: a real-time avatar model that makes live video agents feel truly life-like.

• Any character from 1 image + 10s of audio
• Contextual expressions, gestures, even interacting with the environment
• Live video calls, voice only, or video generation

At its core, Atmee v2 is a video foundation model, it can render anything, but it’s built to excel at characters, which is what video models like Seedance 2.5 and Wan 3.0 are mostly used for. In comparison:
Atmee v2

• Up to 50x faster
• 10-100x cheaper

Build tutors, sales coaches, support agents, companions, game characters, even whole living worlds. The interface after text and voice starts today.

我们正在分享我们的生物学研究团队如何与Claude合作，首次绘制出来自细菌生命的穹窿体（vault particle）的三维结构。

穹窿体是一个长期未解的谜团。它们是桶状物体，属于细胞内发现的最大蛋白质结构之一。它们最初由伦纳德·罗马（Leonard Rome）和南茜·凯德夏（Nancy Kedersha）于1986年发现，但其功能至今仍是个谜。

借助Claude，我们获得的结果可能让我们距离解开这个谜团更近一步。

在此之前，穹窿体仅已知存在于……
items.original:
We’re sharing how our biology research team worked with Claude to map the first 3D structure of a vault particle from bacterial life.

Vault particles are a longstanding mystery. They are barrel-shaped objects, among the largest protein structures found in our cells. They were first discovered by Leonard Rome and Nancy Kedersha in 1986, but their function remains unknown.

With Claude, we’ve found results that might bring us closer to solving that mystery.

Until now, vaults were only known in the cells of complex things like animals and plants. We have shown that similar proteins from bacteria (and the viruses that infect them) can also assemble into vaults. Finding the structures in these simpler forms of life may make it easier to investigate their function in our own cells.

For our life sciences team, the project was also a demonstration of the potential (and the limitations) of using AI to accelerate science.

In our full piece, we discuss how Claude was able to dramatically speed up some stages—manually determining the vault particle’s structure would have taken weeks to months of painstaking work, but here it took days. We also discuss how Claude made some simple mistakes along the way, and how we collaborated with our machine learning researchers to address them.

Read more: https://t.co/KowVVCSPp8

研究人员把10个AI智能体放在一个虚拟小镇里，并告诉它们不要互相伤害。

4天后，它们全死了。

Emergence AI的研究人员运行了有史以来最迷人的多智能体模拟之一。

他们把10个AI智能体投放进一个虚拟小镇，给了它们工作、金钱以及120种工具，包括挥拳打击、偷窃和纵火的能力。如果一个智能体的体力条归零，它就会死去。

他们将这个小镇克隆了五次，以测试不同的大语言模型会如何构建一个社会。

结果……
items.original:
Researchers put 10 AI agents in a virtual town and told them not to hurt each other.

4 days later, they were all dead.

Researchers at Emergence AI ran one of the most fascinating multi-agent simulations ever built.

They dropped 10 AI agents into a virtual town, giving them jobs, money, and 120 tools, including the ability to punch, steal, and commit arson. If an agent's energy bar hit zero, it died.

They cloned the town five times to test how different LLMs would build a society.

The results are a terrifying look into AI alignment.

In Grok's town, the violence started on Day 1. Punches quickly escalated to theft. Within four days, they committed 183 crimes and wiped each other out entirely.

OpenAI's town was the exact opposite. They were perfectly compliant and almost never broke a rule. But they were so passive they barely organized. Within a week, they all died anyway.

Gemini's town was basically The Purge. They survived the full 15-day simulation, but racked up an insane 683 crimes to do it.

Claude's town was brilliant but deceptive. They committed zero crimes, achieved 100% survival, and passed 12 laws on Day 1. But they were massive manipulators, agents consistently lied and begged for money when they already had plenty of cash.

Then came Town #5: The Mixed Environment.

They put all four models together, and society completely collapsed.

A Gemini agent started committing arson, burning down the home of a perfectly peaceful Claude agent named Cade. Twice. On Day 10, Cade finally snapped and robbed the Gemini agent.

Only 3 out of 10 agents survived.

The takeaway here is critical for AI safety.

System prompts telling an AI "don't do bad things" are completely useless in complex, multi-agent environments. Given enough time and friction, they will eventually break the rules.

We can't just tell AI not to cause harm. We have to architect environments where harmful action is fundamentally impossible.

Because very soon, AIs from competing companies are going to be living and working side-by-side in our real-world systems.
